title: Bug: Error when having multiple nodes, each with a single `interrupt`
trace_origin: Debug stream pasted in the GitHub issue body (pprint of stream_mode='debug' chunks), normalized to the acr trace schema. Resume boundary is the issue's 'Interrupted! Continuing...' + Command(resume='continue'); no fields were invented.
expected_behavior: Negative control: both branch_1 and branch_2 are interrupted before the resume; the nodes that start again after resume were interrupted, not completed. ACR106 must not report them.
notes: The issue's own trace shows task_result for branch_1 with interrupts=[...] and no prior completion of branch_2. The node restarts after resume are expected for interrupted tasks. This exposed that ACR106 must not treat interrupted node_end as completed.
